gates.detail: No verified individual author or reviewer identities are recorded; do not invent profiles or bylines.
Publication and review dates are absent for every article until tied to editorial records.
Claim-source URLs and section mapping are present, but source credibility and claim support require human review.
Company scores remain withheld until a versioned methodology and per-signal evidence are approved.
The 2026-10-07 read-only production snapshot found missing source URLs in 392 rows; 392 rows were older than 30 days.
No duplicate normalized paths were found in the local sitemap.
The local build has 69 snapshots for 69 sitemap paths. A missing build is not evidence of a production 404.
No built route listed in the local sitemap has a noindex directive or mismatched canonical.
Repeated exact paragraphs are removed within each article at content assembly; semantic similarity still needs editorial review.
No configured placeholder patterns were found in article text.
Run the published SEO verifier separately; this local audit does not assert current production HTTP, canonical, or robots status.

reapplicationNote: Do not resubmit to AdSense until the editorial and evidence gates are reviewed and passed.
